verdict.rationale: Algolia documents exporting analytics data as CSV or XLSX from the dashboard. The Search API and CLI let you manage indices, records, settings, rules and synonyms, which implies programmatic access for extraction, but there is no explicit documented full-data export. The docs also note that Algolia searches a copy of your data, so the source of truth stays with you, which lowers lock-in. missing for 10: explicit documented export of index records, settings, rules and synonyms in open formats (e.g., JSON dump or browse/export command), a documented account-exit or offboarding path, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full export.
